+ 開 Pull Request"] --> CIGate CIGate{"GitHub Actions CI Gate<br/>build / unit / integ / image / scan"} -->|"FAIL"| Diagnose(("從 Actions log 診斷")) Diagnose --> Implement CIGate -->|"PASS"| Review Review{"Code Owner Review<br/>(required ≥ 1 approval)"} -->|"Changes requested"| Address(("回應 review 意見 / 補測試 / 修補強")) Address --> Implement Review -->|"Approved"| Merge Merge(("Squash + rebase merge to main
